summary.en-US: Open multiple tabs inside native Firefox web app windows.

version.approval_notes: This extension is Windows-only in practice because Firefox native web apps are currently available only on Windows. To test: create a Firefox web app with Add tab to taskbar, focus it, and press Alt+Shift+G. The extension uses browser.tabs.create with the active tab's windowId, causing Firefox to reveal its built-in tab strip. It contains no content scripts, remote code, telemetry, data collection, or network requests. All packaged JavaScript is unminified and human-readable; no separate source archive is required.
